name: Sun Lakes
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Sun Lakes?
answer_short: Yes, on roads posted 35 mph or less. The Sun Lakes Sheriff's Posse says golf carts are not allowed on a road posted over 35 mph, and it names the 45 mph zone of Alma School Road. That road is red on this map.

rules.rule: The 45 mph zone is not a golf cart road
Neighborhood electric vehicles on roads posted 35 mph or less

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Sun Lakes?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Alma School Road?
faq.a: No. The posse says the 45 mph zone is enforced, and this map keeps the whole named road red.

faq.q: What is the speed cap in Sun Lakes?
faq.a: 35 mph. A road posted over 35 mph is closed.
